events.what: White claims τ(H) ≤ 6 for every 4-partite 4-uniform hypergraph with ν(H) = 2, settling the case (r,ν) = (4,2) of Ryser's conjecture
events.credibility_reason: Single-author preprint by an independent researcher, about two weeks old, with the proof produced by a model and checked only by the author's own computations (MILP/enumeration). The ProofAtlas page tracking this problem does not mention it. No specific error has been identified, and the claim is modest (one case, confirming a 1979 Tuza claim), so it is kept.
events.ai_basis: The proof was found through four rounds of structured reasoning with GPT-5.6 Sol (OpenAI, model gpt-5.6-sol-pro) ... Every structural claim returned by the model was independently verified by the author's own exact computation

events.what: Domic and Gallardo give new sufficient conditions under which Ryser's conjecture holds

judgement.doubts: The earlier human correction from claimed to partial is right (F1): the bullet is the whole of Ryser's conjecture, and (4,2) is one case. White's result is unreviewed and rests only on the author's computational checks of the model's claims. It should be rechecked for expert uptake or withdrawal. Domic–Gallardo was judged only from its abstract. The record gives its date as August 2025, but the arXiv ID 2509 suggests submission in September 2025; either way the paper is after the snapshot and cannot set the status.
